task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an fast paced round of TextWorld? You do! Here is your task for today. First thing I need you to do is to move east. Then, move east. And then, attempt to travel east. With that done, take a trip north. And then, lift the latchkey from the floor of the canteen. Got that? Good!
description:
You are in a studio. A serious one. You decide to start listing off everything you see in the room, as if you were in a text adventure.

You can see an armchair. The armchair is usual. However, the armchair, like an empty armchair, has nothing on it. What, you think everything in TextWorld should have stuff on it?

You don't like doors? Why not try going east, that entranceway is unblocked. There is an unguarded exit to the north.
